name: Humbling Yourself
overview: Scripture teaches that humbling oneself is essential to receiving God's grace and wisdom, as pride leads to shame while the lowly are honored and given understanding (Proverbs 3:34; 11:2). True humility involves walking humbly with God, doing justly, and loving mercy, reflecting a heart aligned with His will (Micah 6:8). Jesus emphasizes that those who humble themselves will be exalted, highlighting the divine principle of exaltation through humility (Matthew 23:12). Salvation and access to the Father come solely through Christ by grace through faith, underscoring that humility acknowledges our dependence on Him rather than on ourselves (John 14:6; Ephesians 2:8).
